results.sentence: Setup paragraph: proposer turns source documents into questions with its own answers (pseudo-labels); solver on same Qwen3.5 base trains on them using search tools; proposer rewarded when solver's answers on new questions agree with pseudo-labels, pushing toward the edge of the solver's ability; no human-written labels

results.sentence: Loops that write their own questions avoid costly human labels, but they need some stand-in for truth
